userImpact: On the v2/dsRefresh surface (deliverit-test-v2, the surface under QA toward C0-flip), opening ANY person from the directory navigates to /people/<publicId> (usr_...). The dsRefresh-ON branch (EmployeeDetailsPage.tsx:254->327) renders PersonProfilePanel, which calls GET /api/people/<publicId>/profile and GET /api/people/<publicId>/suggested-positions. Both endpoints use ParseUUIDPipe and reject the usr_ publicId with HTTP 400 'Validation failed (uuid is expected)'. The profile 400 is FATAL: PersonProfilePanel.tsx:99/126 sets error and renders <ErrorState> instead of the profile body, so the entire Person profile (identity, positions, skills, cost, time, manager chain) is unreachable for every real user. The suggested-positions 400 is swallowed (catch -> empty list, lines 117-119), degrading the right-rail 'Suggested next positions' to an empty state. Production / regular-staging is NOT affected because dsRefresh defaults false (feature-flags.ts:199) and the legacy EmployeeDetailsPage path never calls these two endpoints; v2 staging builds force dsRefresh on via VITE_FORCE_FLAGS_ON.
rootCause: ID-type contract mismatch. The FE deep-links with the opaque publicId everywhere: PersonDirectoryInspector.tsx:213 `to={/people/${row.publicId ?? row.id}}`, and EmployeeDirectoryPage.tsx:638/654/741 `navigate(/people/${item.publicId ?? item.id})`. EmployeeDetailsPage.tsx:73 reads that URL segment as `id` and passes it UNCONVERTED into PersonProfilePanel (line 327 `personId={id}`), which forwards it to fetchPersonProfile(personId) -> GET /people/<id>/profile (person-profile.ts:75) and fetchPersonSuggestedPositions(personId) -> GET /people/<id>/suggested-positions (project-positions.ts:312). useEmployeeDetails does NOT resolve publicId->UUID; it only calls /org/people/<id> and stores state.data, never feeding state.data.id (the real UUID) back into the panel. Backend: PersonProfileController.getProfile uses @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) (person-profile.controller.ts:29) and ProjectPositionsController.suggestedPositions uses @Param('personId', ParseUUIDPipe) (project-positions.controller.ts:367) -> UUID-only. Meanwhile the main directory record GET /org/people/:id uses @Param('id', ParsePublicIdOrUuid(AggregateType.Person)) (person-directory.controller.ts:157) and accepts BOTH formats -> that is why /org/people/usr_... returned HTTP 200. Two endpoints on the same person aggregate were never migrated to the publicId-or-uuid pipe that the rest of the People surface adopted (W1-07/08/09).
suggestedFix: Make the two person-scoped endpoints accept publicId like /org/people/:id already does: replace ParseUUIDPipe with ParsePublicIdOrUuid(AggregateType.Person) on PersonProfileController.getProfile (@Param('id'), person-profile.controller.ts:29) and on ProjectPositionsController.suggestedPositions (@Param('personId'), project-positions.controller.ts:367), then resolve the publicId->uuid inside the service the same way EmployeeActivity does (person-directory.controller.ts:177-186). This is the minimal, consistent fix and matches the established W1-09 pattern. (Alternative FE-side fix -- have EmployeeDetailsPage pass the resolved state.data.id UUID to PersonProfilePanel instead of the URL param -- would leak a raw UUID into the call surface and contradicts the no-UUIDs/publicId-deep-link direction, so prefer the BE pipe swap.)
pageState: dsRefresh ON (v2 staging): /people/usr_ed542313b886 renders PageHeader + lifecycle actions, then PersonProfilePanel shows full-panel ErrorState ('Validation failed (uuid is expected)') in place of the entire profile body; right-rail 'Suggested next positions' shows 'No matching open positions right now.' (silent empty). dsRefresh OFF (prod default): legacy EmployeeDetailsPage 6-tab body renders fine because it sources data from /org/people/:id (publicId-tolerant) and never calls /profile or /suggested-positions.
